latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Video Generation Chinese skill.
- Generate 1080p Chinese-language videos from text prompts or scripts, with narration or text overlays.
- Supports quick video creation: upload media, describe desired result, receive downloadable MP4 in 1–3 minutes.
- Cloud-based processing with session management and built-in credit system (100 free credits on sign-up).
- Includes support for uploads, exports, status queries, and timeline previews.
- Handles errors and common workflows for both quick edits and multi-step sessions.
